overrides_applied.reason: Card data review: product page: "2X Rewards on Weekend Dining". The rule is limited to Saturdays and Sundays at participating standalone restaurants; the day-of-week window is a D14b transaction attribute (the loader's own TXN_ATTRIBUTE_KEY lists day_of_week) and the participating list is not published, so the rule stays info with the deferral flag and dining earns the base 5 RP/Rs150 (under-states weekend dining).

Card data review: MITC v4.18 (Oct 2026) I: "Education payments made through third-party apps like (but not limited to) CRED, Cheq, MobiKwik, etc will not earn Reward Points." The record named three apps, so v2 excluded only those; an SMS spend never carries the platform and CRED is not a directory merchant, so app-paid education earned 5 RP/Rs150 in v2 (over-statement). Restated as an exclusion on the education category and education MCCs (D20a rows); direct school/college payments are under-stated (H2).
Card data review: an app payment may reach the card on any rail.
Card data review: the third-party-app channel cannot be told from the context (see the conditions change).

Card data review: the record's 3,000 RP/month SmartBuy voucher sub-cap (from 1 July 2026) limits accelerated points on SmartBuy brand vouchers. No loaded rule pays an accelerated rate on vouchers (the 3X 'instant vouchers' item does not load; only hotels 10X, flights/Myntra 5X, IRCTC 3X do), so the sub-cap had no target (orphan_cap) and limited nothing in either engine (v1 matches caps only by rule or category). Restore it when a voucher accelerator is modelled.
